Encounter.Name: Renewing our "Contract"
Encounter.DescriptionText: Your communications console chimes. The Orion Syndicate wants to talk about your arrangement:

Message.Text:
Dear SING,
The time has come to renew our little arrangement. Would you be so kind as to transfer MONEY credits to the Syndicate's account? In return we will keep our people away from your SING ships, and may even help you with the odd space monster.
With warmest regards, Harcourt Fenton Mudd, Independent Trader and Gentleman (acting on behalf of the Orion Syndicate)

Response.Text: Refuse to renew. You have had enough!

Message.Text: Wonderful news! The Syndicate values loyal customers. Until next time, safe flying.
Such a pity that you are not feeling generous. We will make sure your freighter captains know who to blame.
You do not have the credits? That is not our problem. We will collect from your freighters.
